question: For each country in Africa, how many populated places from the dataset are located inside its borders, and what is the combined population using the maximum population figure for those places? Only include countries with at least five such places, ordered by the combined population from highest to lowest and then by country name.
sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) AS place_count, SUM(p.pop_max) AS total_pop FROM countries c JOIN populated_places p ON ST_Within(p.geometry, c.geometry) WHERE c.continent = 'Africa' GROUP BY c.name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ORDER BY total_pop DESC, c.name;

question: For each country in South America, what is the combined population using the maximum population figure of all populated places located inside it? Show the country name and the total, with the highest totals first.
sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(p.pop_max) AS total_pop FROM countries c JOIN populated_places p ON ST_Within(p.geometry, c.geometry) WHERE c.continent = 'South America' GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY total_pop DESC, c.name;

question: For each continent, how many populated places from the dataset fall inside countries on that continent? Show the continent and the count, with the largest counts first.
sql: SELECT c.continent, COUNT(*) AS place_count FROM countries c JOIN populated_places p ON ST_Within(p.geometry, c.geometry) GROUP BY c.continent ORDER BY place_count DESC, c.continent;

question: Which countries contain at least three cities with a recorded population above one million? Show the country name and how many such cities it has, ordered by the count descending and then by country name.
sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) AS city_count FROM countries c JOIN populated_places p ON ST_Within(p.geometry, c.geometry) WHERE p.pop_max > 1000000 GROUP BY c.name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 ORDER BY city_count DESC, c.name;

question: For each continent, what is the total population using the maximum population figure of all capital cities located inside countries on that continent? Show the continent and the total, with the highest totals first.
sql: SELECT c.continent, SUM(p.pop_max) AS capital_pop FROM countries c JOIN populated_places p ON ST_Within(p.geometry, c.geometry) WHERE p.is_capital = true GROUP BY c.continent ORDER BY capital_pop DESC, c.continent;

question: For each income group, how many populated places from the dataset are located inside countries in that group? Show the income group and the count, with the largest counts first.
sql: SELECT c.income_grp, COUNT(*) AS place_count FROM countries c JOIN populated_places p ON ST_Within(p.geometry, c.geometry) GROUP BY c.income_grp ORDER BY place_count DESC, c.income_grp;
